facts.fact: Chief Minister Sengeh said the National Investment Board's One-Stop Digital Business Service Platform, built through a joint venture, is nearly complete and expected to be operational by November 2026, cutting business registration from about 24 hours to minutes.

SLE.note: Only physical facilities at the NIB building are mentioned, nothing on information or digital services.
The business platform is not yet launched; the document states a forward date only, and it is recorded under businessregister.
A joint venture is mentioned with no partner or amount named.
